name: PER_AOR_ASG_GT
description: This global temporary table holds the details of assignment details for a thread and this will be used to calculate assignment representatives .

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: This is a system generated primary key. Surrogate key.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifies person holding an assignment or a set of Employment/Placement Terms. Foreign key to PER_PERSONS.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies the type of record: either assignment (employee, CWK, applicant, non-workers) or a set of Terms.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Department Identifier, it is optional.

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_JOBS_F.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HR_LOCATIONS_ALL_F.

columns.name: POSITION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_ALL_POSITIONS_F.

columns.name: GRADE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_GRADES_F.

columns.name: BARGAINING_UNIT_CODE
columns.description: Bargaining unit code.

columns.name: EMPLOYMENT_CATEGORY
columns.description: User defined category. For example Full-Time Permanent or Part-Time Permanent. Lookup Type = ?EMP_CAT?.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE
columns.description: Denormalized status of the assignment. This is derived using the Assignment Status Type ID.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the order of different changes made during a day. The lowest value represents the earliest change in the day.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Represents Legal Entity. Might be null for Applicants.

columns.name: LEGISLATION_CODE
columns.description: Legislation code derived from the Legal Entity. Might be null for Applicants.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Determinant for ?Set Enabled? tables and those using BU as a partitioning key.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: 'Y' indicates that this row represents the latest change in the day.
